model.name: M1 node 'add Repository' action — reuse the three-way-diff selector to attach a gh Repository + a Project (existing OR new); result shows in the M1 tree
model.description: Tron 'radical oop classes top down scenario first planned'. On the M1 node (mof-m1; detail: Scenario/Edit/Add folder/Rename/Import PUML) add an action named EXACTLY 'add Repository'. It opens a selector MODELLED ON the three-way-diff selector (REUSE the existing repo/branch chooser diffEditor.repoTargeting + RepoRegistry, do NOT fork a 2nd picker) to select (a) a GitHub Repository + (b) a Project within it, PLUS a 'NEW project' action (existing OR new). Radical-OOP: Repository (41.4 M1 class) HAS-A Project (its own class, PO-ruled); the selector + actions are OWNED BY those classes, never free functions.
model.tronQuote: radical oop classes top down scenario first planned
model.poDirective: PO 2026-09-13 (Tron order, halt lifted): mint req+UCs+class hops top-down for the M1-node 'add Repository' action; reuse the three-way-diff selector, no dup; task-home on the T41.4 line (planner).
model.reuseNote: REUSES the existing three-way-diff selector (diffEditor.repoTargeting 522473f3 / RepoRegistry.list 2368167a) — no second picker. Repository=9be9df2f (41.4). Project class MINTED here (absent; 3 Project instances existed, no Class — like File).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The 'add Repository' action (named EXACTLY 'add Repository') is VISIBLE on the M1 node (mof-m1) detail panel, alongside Scenario / Edit / Add folder / Rename / Import PUML.

gateRef.assertion: the M1 node detail shows an 'add Repository' action; absent => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: remove the action from the M1 node detail -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The action opens a selector MODELLED ON / REUSING the existing three-way-diff repo/branch chooser (diffEditor.repoTargeting + RepoRegistry) — NO second picker forked — and it lists REAL gh repositories.

gateRef.assertion: the selector is the reused three-way-diff chooser + lists real gh repos; a forked 2nd picker OR a stubbed repo list => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: fork a second repo picker instead of reusing the three-way-diff selector -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: An EXISTING Project within the selected repository can be selected and ATTACHED (Repository HAS-A Project).

gateRef.assertion: an existing Project is attached to the Repository; cannot attach an existing project => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: A NEW Project can be CREATED (via a 'NEW project' action inside the selector) AND attached — Tron can add EITHER an existing OR a new project.

gateRef.assertion: a new Project is created via the selector's NEW-project action + attached; missing new-project path => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: remove the NEW-project action / make new-project create+attach impossible -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: After attach, the M1 TREE SHOWS the result — the attached Repository + Project as REAL modelled M1 units (owned, fully-qualified IOR), not a path string; live (R41.3 observer shape, no forced reload).

gateRef.assertion: the M1 tree renders the attached Repository+Project as modelled units after attach; a bare string / no tree update => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: attach a repo/project that does not appear as a modelled unit in the M1 tree -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The selector + the actions are METHODS OWNED BY the classes (Repository HAS-A Project; the action + attach on Repository/Project), NEVER free functions. A free-function selector/action => RED.

gateRef.assertion: the add-Repository action + selector + attach are class methods; a free function implementing them => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: implement the action/selector as a free function -> RED
